title: Mosca2 — Flash Loan-Based join/exit Repeat Manipulation: Second Attack Analysis
root_cause: Lack of fund source validation in join/exit functions allows external funds to be treated as legitimate deposits (unpatched after 1st attack)
steps: → [1] DODO DPP Flash Loan: borrow 7,000 BUSD
Deposit using flash loan funds → no validation
